description:
Following the faceless god Hitogami's advice seems to have worked wonders for Rudeus Greyrat. After enrolling into the University of Magic as he was told, Rudeus reunites with his childhood friend Sylphiette, who put a valiant effort into curing his condition. The two grow ever closer together and decide to host a wedding party, inviting the friends they have made over the years to announce and formalize their relationship.

For all his recent blessings, however, Rudeus' troubles are far from over. The research he is helping Shizuka Nanahoshi conduct hits a bottleneck, sending her into a deep slump much like he experienced in his previous life. Furthermore, a letter from his father, Paul, brings complications to Rudeus' relationships, and Sylphiette still knows next to nothing about his real background. In the face of these issues, Rudeus will have to apply the lessons he has learned in this new world to navigate through the challenges that come with living a life to its fullest.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

name.native: ロキシー・ミグルディア

node.description:
Roxy Migurdia is a talented mage from the Migurd race, and a former magic tutor. Because she can't use telepathy, she left her village due to feeling isolated from her peers. Unable to make a stable living as an adventurer, she became a travelling tutor and eventually becomes [Rudeus'](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) teacher.

~!She is Rudeus' second wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/273376/Greyrat-Lara) & [Lily](https://anilist.co/character/321620/Greyrat-Lily). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. Her panties that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Wisdom is enshrined in the basement.!~

name.native: ルーデウス・グレイラット

node.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Rudeus is a tall, well-built, and cool-looking man. However, before his reincarnation, he was originally an overweight 34-year-old Japanese NEET who became a recluse following his high-school persecution. Because of his former life, he is careful not to get carried away and become arrogant. As a result, he is extremely self-aware and humble because he does not want to revert to his old self. He is a kind person, helping his friends and protecting his family whenever needed. Due to being capable in many fields, people have high expectations of him. His body possesses a high affinity for magic. Rudeus is very polite to others, often to the point of making them uncomfortable.

Rudeus is one of the few people capable of using voiceless magic, and even rarer as someone who can use voiceless incantation with melded magics. He cannot use voiceless incantation for healing magic due to his lack of understanding in regards to how mana is manipulated to heal. A normal Magician takes at least five seconds for a simple spell, while for higher-level spells it's thirty to sixty seconds. Rudeus can do it almost instantly no matter what the difficulty of the spell, with the exception of healing magic.

node.description:
Eris Boreas Greyrat is a noble girl and distant relative of [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat). She is a tsundere with a short temper but has potential in the Sword-God style.

~!She is Rudeus' third wife and gives birth to their son [Ars](https://anilist.co/character/273378/Greyrat-Ars) and daughter [Christina](https://anilist.co/character/278862/Greyrat-Christina). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A wooden sword that serves as a relic for the Goddess of War is enshrined in the basement.!~

Sylphiette is [Rudeus'](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) childhood friend who is part human, elf, and beast race.

~!Following the teleportation incident, during which her hair turned white from mana exhaustion, she became Princess Ariel's personal bodyguard under the alias Fitz.!~

~!She is Rudeus' first wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/188846/Greyrat-Lucy) and son [Sieghardt](https://anilist.co/character/273377/Greyrat-Saladin-Sieghardt). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A cloth stained with her virgin blood that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Love is enshrined in the basement.!~

name.native: ルイジェルド・スペルディア

node.description:
Ruijerd Superdia is the former leader of the Superd's Warrior group whom once served under Laplace with unwavering loyalty. He was accompanying [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat).

~!Laplace betrayed his group by giving them each a devil spear which made them ecstatic from killing, even their own family. After giving his son a fatal wound, his son managed to destroy the devil spear and Ruijerd finally wakes up from the brainwash. He considered committing suicide but decided not to and everyone of that warrior group swore revenged on Laplace.

He finally got his revenge after several years of hiding. He interfered in the battle between Laplace and the three heroes. But even if Laplace was defeated, there was no way to change the things that had already transpired.

After exacting his revenge, he now has a goal of removing the infamy the Superd race has.!~

name.native: ゼニス・グレイラット

node.description:
Zenith Greyrat is the wife of [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347) and the mother of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat).

~!Zenith was born in the Holy Country of Milis, as the second daughter of an earl of Milis. She grew up following the Milis Church religion, never breaking the rules, getting good grade in school, and had nickname Milis young lady standard. But, when Zenith reached the age of 15, she rebelled against her parents and ran away from home.

While trying to find a job as a Healer, she was a solo adventurer for a time. However she was frequently conned out of a large amount of money due to the little knowledge she had on how expensive healer's are, but was saved by Paul Greyrat. She then join Paul's party, the Fangs of the Black Wolf, as a healer. She spent a long time in the party as a healer and gradually began to fall in love with Paul and wanted to marry him. However Paul was a womanizer who frequently slept with multiple women and she didn't want to be with someone like that so she told him if he promised to be faithful to her then she would sleep with him, to which he agreed.
Shortly after, she became pregnant with Rudeus and as a result both her and Paul retired from adventuring and settled down in the countryside.!~


__Light Novel Volume 13 Spoiler__
~!After being freed from the Teleport Labyrinth, she does not express emotions actively since she sees the world around her as if she were in a trance or dream. Occasionally she will display actions that show her emotions, such as when she smiled at Norn or hit Rudeus when he said he was going to add Eris to his family as a wife, which shows signs of her personality basically unchanged but hidden and suppressed by her dream state caused by her Miko Powers.!~

node.description: Norn Greyrat is the daughter of [Zenith Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) and [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat) and is the younger sister of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and older half-sister of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat).

Lilia is a maid of the Greyrat household. She was [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat)'s classmate in a swordsman dojo. A crippling injury forces her to leave her position as a princess guard, and she becomes a maid to Paul and [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat).

~!After working through the revelation with the family, she is taken in as Paul's second wife and becomes closer friends with Zenith. Lillia gets pregnant with Paul's daughter and becomes the mother of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat)!~

Zanoba Shirone is a doll loving prince of Shirone. When he was three years old, he killed his brother, the Fourth prince, as if his brother was a doll. When he was 15 years old, he killed his wife, as if she was a doll.

node.description: Second Princess of the Asura Kingdom. She is hardly ever seen without her two bodyguards, [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/226703) and "[Silent Fitz](https://anilist.co/character/88346)". After surviving many assassination attempts, she and her bodyguards flee to The Magic City of Sharia and enroll at  the Ranoa Magic Academy.

Cliff Grimoire is the Grandson of the Pope, and a friend of Rudeus. 

Cliff has a very high amount of pride, so much so that he will proudly tell people when they ask him for help. Though this trait may irk many people it cannot be said that he is arrogant since he is shown to be constantly studying to improve himself showing that he is very diligent as well. He is also very loyal to his friends, since it is shown that if he is asked for help, then that becomes his main priority

node.description: Juliette is an orphaned Dwarf and slave purchased by Rudeus and Zanoba with the purpose of helping them in the making of dolls. She was acquired because she fit the criteria of being a child, a Dwarf and by being a Dwarf having dexterous hands, which is preferable in doll-making. She's wary of Rudeus to an extent because of him befitting the behaviour of a folklore individual characterised by typical traits parents tell their children to deter them.

name.native: ギース・ヌーカディア

node.description:
Geese is of the Magic Race, the last surviving tribe member, heritage and is introduced into the series when his and Rudeus's paths collide in a shared jail cell located in the Great Forest. Rudeus address Geese by the nickname of "Newbie" during their time together. He is a Jack of all Trades that can do almost everything, except fighting for the most part.

~!He's a former member of the adventurer party "Fang of the Black Wolf", a party in which Paul and Zenith were former members of. Geese vowed to never teach another woman cooking again after he taught Zenith, which lead to the eventual demise of the party. The connection being that Zenith wanted to impress Paul and after succeeding they left the party which lead to the dissolution.!~

Engaged to the Great Demon Emperor Kishirika Kishirisu, it is said that he is the demon lord who grants wisdom to those who deserve it. He is the current Fighting God and has been alive even before the war with Laplace. He has an immortal body, being able to regenerate injuries and body parts instantly.

~!He disappears later in the series with his whereabouts unknown, to reappear once again as Hitogami's apostle.!~

Hitogami is the Man God, having the power to see into the future, and the sworn enemy of [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382). He has a blank white face coupled with a grin that eludes memory, which gives off the feeling that his face is covered in a mosaic. He helps [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) throughout key points in his journey.

~!Hitogami later becomes the overarching antagonist of the series following the revelation that he actually sought to prevent the birth of Rudeus' children, who are prophesied to kill him one day.!~

~!Hitogami's exact origins are unknown, however it is known that after the Creator God's death, unbeknownst to anyone, he was born within the Void World. At some point in the distant past, the being who would come to be known as Hitogami killed or otherwise usurped the original Man God and took his form. He then began manipulating the Dragon God and his five Dragon Generals into destroying the other four worlds and then proceeded to help the survivors of those ruined world to flee into the human world.!~

node.description:
Luke Notos Greyrat is the second prince of the Asura kingdom Ariel Anemoi Asura's personal guardian and also holds the status of Knight. 
He's also the cousin of Rudeus Greyrat, but from another of the four different branch families in the Greyrat genus, namely the Notos family.
She was caught with her sister, Shierra, in the mana calamity. After being saved by Paul, she helps with finding all the missing people.
A dwarf that was member of the Party "Fang of the Black Wolf", with Elinalise and Roxy. He is slow and not agile, so he wears sturdy armor, wields an axe, and uses magic against enemies.
Ginger is a loyal subordinate of Zanoba and a former imperial guard.
One of the key members of Paul's search party. She was caught with her sister Vierra in the mana calamity, and the two were enslaved by bandits until Paul and his group rescue them.
